resources.string: Detects when a non-allowed app opens during an active Lock Now session or Schedule, returns to the Home screen, and immediately locks the device.
Allows VaultLock to lock the screen on Android 8 and below (or as a primary lock method) and prevents accidental uninstallation while active.
Displays the live lock countdown and quick access to your allowed apps drawer.
Alerts you before a scheduled phone lockdown starts.
